WHAT WE BUILD

Two focused services: build the custom software your business needs, then keep it healthy with automated QA agents that test like real users.

AI-Enhanced Custom Software Development

We design and build custom web apps, internal tools, customer portals, integrations, and workflow systems using senior engineering plus AI-assisted development. The result is faster delivery without handing quality over to automation.

Automated QA with AI Agents

We deploy AI agents that explore your web app, run critical user journeys, check forms and workflows, capture screenshots, and summarize failures in plain English. Use it before launches, after deployments, or as continuous regression coverage.

Read the OAQA article
Integrations & Workflow Systems

When your CRM, billing system, website, spreadsheets, and operations tools do not talk to each other, we build the connective tissue: APIs, sync jobs, admin screens, and dashboards that match how your team works.

Regression Test Suites

We turn your most important workflows into repeatable AI-assisted test runs: login, checkout, booking, quote acceptance, admin updates, email triggers, and other paths that cannot break quietly.

Modernization & Feature Delivery

If your existing system is slow to change, we can add features, refactor fragile areas, improve developer velocity, and introduce AI-supported testing without forcing a risky rewrite.

Quality Reports & Release Checks

QA agents produce practical output: what passed, what failed, where it failed, screenshots, reproduction notes, and recommended fixes. Your team gets signal instead of a pile of brittle test logs.
